notes.title: Development Update
notes.content: [p]The Thieves Guild questline has been fully implemented.  All that is left to do now are general housekeeping, one-off minor quests and dialogs to build immersion in the game, and then a demo will be released.[/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content: [p]All 3 separate endings are now completed! The 'good' ending also has an adaptive scene that will be different depending on whether you complete a set of side quests or not. I'm now working on adding in the remaining guild questlines and side-quests from the Nothmere villagers.[/p]
